title: Lifecycle request
description: POST /lifecycle. An operator changing the add-on's state at runtime. The add-on decodes it strictly.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 1: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

reason.description: Required and non-blank: a state nobody explained is indistinguishable from a fault.

LifecycleState.description: active accepts work; draining finishes what is running and refuses more; read_only serves reads only.
